full_judgment: 3. The question involved and the decision proposed to be given does not call for any detailed recounting of facts except that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 12 of 1989 in the Court of Assistant Judge at Upazila Srimongal, District Moulvibazar impleading the opposite party No. 1 as principal defendant and opposite party Nos. 2 and 3 as proforma defendants, for a decree of permanent injunction restraining the defendant No. 1, from interfering with their lawful possession on the suit property and also from dispossessing them by force there from. The predecessor of the plaintiffs and the proforma defendant Nos. 2 and 3 entered into a contract for sale with Tripura Modern Bank and a Bainapatra was executed on December 7, 1953. The predecessor of the plaintiffs and on their death the plaintiffs and proforma defendants are in possession of the suit land to the knowledge of all concerned including the defendant No. 1. The defendant No. 1 got no right and possession on the suit property. He threatened the plaintiffs to disposes them from the suit land and thus, the suit has been filed.
